analogy.name: A barista with a buzzer
analogy.line: One barista takes orders one at a time (call stack). The coffee machine works in the background (Web APIs) and your buzzer goes off when it is ready (callback queue).

analogy.name: Spell check that vanishes when you print
analogy.line: Types are checked while you write, then erased in the JavaScript that ships. Nothing checks them at runtime.

analogy.name: Airport security lanes
analogy.line: Each checkpoint (middleware) inspects you and either passes you on with next() or stops you. The gate (handler) only sees passengers who got through all of them.
